items.title: Higher direct images of quasi-coherent sheaves vanish past degree one for proper maps with at-most-curve fibres, and the first direct image vanishes for globally generated sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y whose fibres have dimension at most 1 and satisfy H^1 of the structure sheaf equal to zero everywhere, the lemma shows R^p f_* F is zero for p > 1 for any quasi-coherent F, R^1 f_* F vanishes when F is a quotient of the pullback of a quasi-coherent sheaf on Y, and over affine Y the global groups vanish in all degrees except 0 and 1 with H^1 vanishing for globally generated F. The retained proof is written: the degree bound is Limits, lemma-higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre; reduction (2) to (4) uses quasi-coherence of higher direct images on affine bases (Cohomology of Schemes, lemmas quasi-coherence-higher-direct-images and its application); (4) itself takes a surjection from a free direct sum, uses the long exact sequence together with part (1) to push surjectivity onto H^1, the vanishing H^1(X, O_X) from lemma-h1-fibre-zero, and commutation of H^1 with direct sums (Cohomology, lemma-quasi-separated-cohomology-colimit). Retained author proof at lines 20988-21015.
